Maize_Common_rust.symptoms: Small, circular to elongated reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
Maize_Common_rust.immediate_actions: Remove and destroy heavily infected lower leaves.
Maize_Common_rust.cultural_controls: Plant resistant varieties. Practice crop rotation with non-host crops.
Maize_Common_rust.prevention: Ensure balanced soil fertility. Avoid late planting.
Maize_Common_rust.when_to_seek_expert: If pustules spread rapidly to the upper canopy.
Maize_Common_rust.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Rectangular, gray to tan lesions bounded by leaf veins.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.immediate_actions: Clear crop debris after harvest to reduce spore carryover.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.cultural_controls: Use certified disease-free seeds. Plow down infected stubble.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.prevention: Ensure adequate plant spacing for air circulation.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.when_to_seek_expert: If lesions reach the ear leaf before grain fill.
Maize_Gray_leaf_spot.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical or cigar-shaped gray-green lesions.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.immediate_actions: Scout fields weekly during warm, humid weather.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.cultural_controls: Rotate with beans or cowpeas. Use resistant hybrids.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.when_to_seek_expert: If lesions appear on the top 3 leaves during silking.
Maize_Northern_Leaf_Blight.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Potato_Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings (target board appearance).
Potato_Early_blight.immediate_actions: Remove and destroy infected leaves immediately.
Potato_Early_blight.cultural_controls: Ensure adequate potassium fertilization. Rotate crops for 2-3 years.
Potato_Early_blight.prevention: Use certified seed potatoes. Hill up soil around plants.
Potato_Early_blight.when_to_seek_expert: If stem lesions or tuber rot is observed.
Potato_Early_blight.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Potato_Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked pale green spots that turn purplish-black. White mold under leaves.
Potato_Late_blight.immediate_actions: Destroy all cull piles and volunteer potato plants.
Potato_Late_blight.cultural_controls: Plant resistant varieties. Ensure good drainage.
Potato_Late_blight.prevention: Do not irrigate in the evening. Harvest when tubers are mature.
Potato_Late_blight.when_to_seek_expert: Immediately upon seeing the first water-soaked lesion.
Potato_Late_blight.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Tomato_Early_blight.symptoms: Small dark spots with concentric rings on older, lower leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.immediate_actions: Prune and remove infected lower leaves.
Tomato_Early_blight.cultural_controls: Stake plants for airflow. Mulch to prevent soil splashing.
Tomato_Early_blight.prevention: Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 3 years.
Tomato_Early_blight.when_to_seek_expert: If spots move up the stem or reach the fruit.
Tomato_Early_blight.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Tomato_Late_blight.symptoms: Large, irregular, greasy gray-green spots. Rapid plant death.
Tomato_Late_blight.immediate_actions: Destroy infected plants immediately. Do not compost.
Tomato_Late_blight.cultural_controls: Avoid overhead watering. Space plants widely.
Tomato_Late_blight.prevention: Plant in raised beds. Use certified disease-free transplants.
Tomato_Late_blight.when_to_seek_expert: Immediately. This disease destroys crops in days.
Tomato_Late_blight.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.

Tomato_Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Yellow spots on upper leaf surface. Olive-green fuzzy mold underneath.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.cultural_controls: Use drip irrigation. Avoid working among wet plants.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.prevention: Use resistant tomato varieties. Sanitize tools.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.when_to_seek_expert: If mold covers more than 20% of the leaf area.
Tomato_Leaf_Mold.safety_note: ALWAYS wear protective gear when spraying. Keep away from water sources.
